title: Grapes
body:
"Grapes are small, juicy fruits that grow in clusters on vines."

Description

Grapes is a item that can be found on bushes near the Lighthouse area.

It may be sold to Jer Junkman for $100 per Grapes. In its jam form it may be sold for $400.

Slows the player down when eaten.

When put into a Composter, the fill level increases by ~1.18% per bunch of grape grapes.
